[DAY2 17:25:00 - DAY2 17:25:30]
I plug the device into the power strip. Alice: I thought about it yesterday. Alice: I just couldn't find the shade of blue I liked. Alice: But... I watch him pick up the bottle. Alice: So I switched to... I put it aside. Alice: A forest kind of vibe. Lucia: Ah, right now... Alice: Hmm, green, actually I'm not a big fan of green. I'm on my bed. Lucia: Right now... Lucia: I'm thinking of doing something Mediterranean. I look around. I move the tissues. Alice: Ocean. Lucia: Yeah, yeah, that kind of style. Lucia: So I want to buy another... I almost get up but don't. I pick up the item from the box. Lucia: Another fishnet. Lucia: Then we can hang it up. I put it down again. Lucia: I was just thinking about how to hang it nicely. Alice: That fishnet... Alice: If you hang it, maybe you can buy some jellyfish decorations. Lucia: Buy some jellyfish decorations. I touch the other box. I set it aside. Lucia: Or shells, that kind of elements. I tug my blanket. I stand up. Lucia: Yeah, I was thinking the same. Lucia: Just to decorate it a bit. I look around. Lucia: But I'm still thinking about how to hang it.

[DAY2 17:36:30 - DAY2 17:36:59]
I pick up the thread. Lucia: "Isn't it amazing?" I move my backpack a little. Alice: "I thought we were copying and pasting proportionally." I organize the lines and my charging cables. Lucia: "Haha, our room layout is the same." Lucia: "But the things inside are a bit different." I pick up the charger. Lucia: "Hmm." Lucia: "Get a piece of blue cloth or something." I put the cloth on the bed. Lucia: "Make the bed properly." I pick something up, glance around, pick up my bag, take out a bottle of mineral water, then put the bag down.

[DAY2 17:36:00 - DAY2 17:36:30]
I pick up a bottle of mineral water and put it down. Lucia: "Oh, hey." Lucia: "This looks nice." I open a bag. Lucia: "I only have a shelf in mine." Lucia: "The arrangement is similar to this." I put items into the bag. Alice: "Isn't it the same today?" I throw the bag onto the bed. Lucia: "But it doesn't have a table." I pick up the water bottle and the charger. Lucia: "It only has a shelf." Lucia: "I was thinking of putting another." Lucia: "So." I toss the water bottle into a box. Lucia: "Small storage box on the shelf." Lucia: "To make it tidier." I make the bed, straightening it repeatedly, and place the box on the right. Lucia: "Ah, this small lamp looks nice." I pick up my backpack. Alice: "Hmm." Lucia: "I said that small lamp looks nice." I let it go. I reach my hand under the covers and look for something. Alice: "You don't have a lamp?" Lucia: "I don't." Alice: "You only have the ceiling light, right?" Lucia: "Right." I pick up my laptop and move it to the right.

[DAY2 17:23:31 - DAY2 17:24:00]
I walk into the living room and pace back and forth. Lucia asks, "If we have the budget, can I buy a doll and use it as a decoration and take it back later?" "Sure," I say. I walk toward my bedroom door, enter the room, and look around. Lucia adds, "As long as it matches my style." I fiddle with the thread and run my fingers over the line on my hand as I look for a place to put him. Alice asks, "How's the design going?" I move the chair and then move the table.

[DAY2 22:53:31 - DAY2 22:54:00]
I listen as Lucia says, "Right now I'm thinking of a blue and white theme" and "The color scheme would be kind of Mediterranean style." He gestures with both hands while my friends and I quietly listen and I nod. Lucia says, "Or maybe something like 'facing the sea'" and "Spring blossoms," then suggests a photo wall with fishing nets and shells, photo stickers and postcards, and says he'll check the layout and bed placement tomorrow because the bed takes up a lot of space.

[DAY2 22:54:00 - DAY2 22:54:30]
Lucia: "I was thinking of buying a blue one." I look at Shure and Katrina and listen. Lucia: "You know, one that matches the room's color and brightness, or maybe buy two small cushions — like, um... or some other sea creature, maybe a shark." I watch Lucia gesture with both hands and nod approvingly. Lucia: "And that's about it. The curtain color can't really be changed." I keep watching as he waves the curtains once. Lucia: "Right." "The window is pretty big," I say. I chat with Lucia and ask, "What's outside the window?" Lucia: "When you open the window, it's just the house across the street. Yeah, and I was thinking of maybe getting a small night light."
